scientific_integrity: Exact finite enumeration is reproducible with two independent programs; all inference beyond these finite cases is excluded. This is neither an independent certificate nor a claim of priority.
scientific_limitations: The complete geometric quotient classification applies only to 4, 5, 6, and 7 phylogenetic leaves. It depends on classical tree-link, orbit fundamental-group, Hurewicz and Whitehead theorems; an independent audit was not performed and literature-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Dihedral orbit topology of phylogenetic tree links through seven leaves
